title: Speed, Distance and Time
seo_title: Speed, Distance and Time – Primary 6 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Calculate speed, distance and time; find the duration of journeys; use the 24-hour clock in timetables. (summary of the NERDC Primary 6 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 6 maths worksheets on speed, distance and time: average speed in km/h, distance travelled, time taken, journey times and the 24-hour clock. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Distance = speed × time, time = distance ÷ speed.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. It is measured in km/h (kilometres per hour).
  • Distance = speed × time. Time = distance ÷ speed.
  • Change minutes to hours before you use the formula: 30 minutes = ½ hour.

Examples

Example

150 km in 2½ hours

150 ÷ 2.5

Answer: 60 km/h

Example

At 80 km/h for 3 hours

80 × 3

Answer: 240 km

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using 30 minutes as 0.3 hours30 minutes = 0.5 hours.
Multiplying instead of dividingSpeed = distance ÷ time.
Mixing km and mUse km with km/h.
